purpose.zh: 练肩部推举力量，为倒立做准备
purpose.en: Build overhead pressing strength as prep for handstands.

text.zh: 臀部保持高位，屈肘让头向手前方下沉
text.en: Keep your hips high and bend your elbows to lower your head just ahead of your hands

text.zh: 倒V字，双手与肩同宽，腿伸直
text.en: Make an inverted V with hands shoulder-width and legs straight.

text.zh: 手肘约45度向后，再推回手臂伸直
text.en: Angle your elbows back about 45 degrees, then press back to straight arms.

commonErrors.zh: 臀部下沉变成普通俯卧撑
commonErrors.en: Dropping the hips into a regular push-up.

cautions.zh: 先做2–3分钟手腕热身；腕部刺痛或麻木立即停止
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists for 2–3 minutes first; stop right away if they feel sharp pain or numbness.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小下放深度
cautions.en: Lower less deep if your shoulders hurt.
